validity.description: Deterministic one-second transit selected to verify the M4 component boundary and serial region semantics.

sources.citation: Wendt, Regine (2024), Einsatz von Nanotechnologien in der Präzisionsmedizin, Section 4.4, pp. 126-129
sources.license: source consulted; facts and architecture paraphrased

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M4 capillary-component contract, version 1.0.0

limitations: Path counts and transit times are synthetic software-test values, not physiological evidence.
Perfused path count is validated metadata; flow redistribution and sphincter dynamics are not implemented in M4.1.
Substances pass through without exchange, reaction, retention, adhesion, or extravasation.
The model has no geometry, pressure, hematocrit, local position, stochastic dispersion, or molecular channel.
